verdict.rationale: Stable publishes a documented public API with authentication (x-api-key header), endpoints for MailItems, Locations, Companies, Checks, onboarding, webhooks, and API key management via dashboard, all backed by detailed reference docs and an llms.txt index confirming the docs site is live. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (all candidate paths 404'd) and no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API usage.
